method: 20 serial fresh-fixture runs; Node process CPU user+system (quantized on Windows), host wall time to response headers; workerd CPU and deployed CPU unavailable. Batches are total times for 100 operations, not individual invocation percentiles. Nearest-rank percentiles; includes cold/first calls; no concurrent benchmark requests. No credentials/bodies/headers in evidence.
